title: Supply Chain Security for the Age of AI-Speed Exploits
description: Learn Python supply chain security as AI speeds up attacks: what the LiteLLM backdoor teaches, how to check your setup, and habits that last.
summary: Python supply chain security means protecting everything your project pulls in and runs, from PyPI packages to CI workflows and publishing credentials, so that a tampered release or stolen token can’t turn your own tools against you. AI-assisted analysis makes it cheaper to turn a bug fix into a working exploit, so attacks now arrive within hours of a fix, and sometimes before it.
takeaways: LiteLLM 1.107.0: Code That Runs on Every Python Start LiteLLM is a popular Python library and proxy for calling many AI model providers through one API .
Calif worked as part of OpenAI’s Patch the Planet initiative and credits OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol model, and Wiz used Gemini 4 Argon and GPT-5.6 Sol.
